title: LIAR GAME

opinions.point: Most commenters enjoyed the episode and considered it a strong season finale, especially praising its surprises and clever mind games.
Character reactions were strongly favorable, with repeated appreciation for Nao's growth and the ensemble's entertaining chemistry.
Several commenters praised the voice acting and especially the memorable delivery of one antagonist's lines.
Some readers found the show's schemes occasionally difficult to follow and felt the early pacing could have been faster.
Multiple comments criticized the limited animation budget and low visual quality, though some felt this became part of the show's charm.

notes: The title and page metadata explicitly identify Liar Game episode 26. Reddit exposed the discussion text but not reliable current score or comment-count metadata in the retrieved page, so those fields are reported as 0. Comment summaries are paraphrased and spoiler-free.
